Missivus.PluginDescription: Send all Matomo email through the Microsoft Graph API using application permissions and a shared mailbox. No user login, no delegated OAuth, no SMTP.
Missivus.SettingEnabledDescription: When this is off, Matomo keeps using its own mail settings. Turn it on once the fields below are filled in and the test email works.
Missivus.SettingTenantIdDescription: The Directory (tenant) ID shown on your app registration's Overview page in Microsoft Entra.
Missivus.SettingClientIdDescription: The Application (client) ID shown on your app registration's Overview page in Microsoft Entra.
Missivus.SettingAuthMethodDescription: How Matomo proves it is your application. A certificate is recommended: it does not expire as quickly as a secret and never travels in a request body.
Missivus.SettingClientSecretDescription: The secret Value from Certificates & secrets in your app registration. It is stored write-only and is never shown again or written to the log.
Missivus.SettingCertificatePathDescription: Absolute path on this server to a PEM file containing both the private key and the certificate. Keep it outside the plugin directory, readable only by the web server user.
Missivus.SettingCertificatePassphraseDescription: Only needed if the private key is encrypted. Stored write-only and never shown again or written to the log.
Missivus.SettingSenderMailboxDescription: The shared mailbox every email is sent from, for example noreply@example.com.
Missivus.SettingSenderMailboxHelp: This address is also forced as the From address on every email, because application-only sending cannot use any other. Set noreply_email_address in the [General] section of config.ini.php to the same address.
Missivus.SettingSaveToSentItemsTitle: Keep a copy in Sent Items
Missivus.SettingSaveToSentItemsDescription: Store every sent email in the shared mailbox's Sent Items folder. Off by default, so a no-reply mailbox does not fill up.
Missivus.SettingFallbackTitle: Fall back to Matomo's own mail settings
Missivus.SettingFallbackDescription: If Microsoft Graph fails, try again using Matomo's configured SMTP or PHP mail settings. Off by default: a failure you can see is better than an email that quietly goes nowhere. The failure is written to the log either way.
Missivus.SettingTestEmailDescription: Save your settings first, then send a test email to check the whole path end to end. The exact error from Microsoft is shown if it fails.
Missivus.SetInConfigFileDescription: This value comes from the [Missivus] section of config.ini.php (or the MISSIVUS_%1$s environment variable) and cannot be changed here. Edit that file to change it.
Missivus.TestEmailBody: This is a test email sent by the Missivus plugin through the Microsoft Graph API, from the mailbox %1$s. If you are reading it, Matomo can send email.
Missivus.TestEmailSentTo: Test email sent to %1$s. Check that it arrives — Microsoft accepted it, which is not quite the same as delivering it.
Missivus.TestEmailNoRecipient: No recipient. Enter an address, or add one to your own Matomo user account.
